sloka: शतानि सप्त चाष्टौ च विंशत्ऺित्रंशत्तथैव च।सम्परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्यां खादन् विपरिधावति ।। ६.६७.१०१ ।।
transliteration: śatāni sapta cāṣṭau ca viṁśatऺitraṁśattathaiva ca।sampariṣvajya bāhubhyāṁ khādan viparidhāvati ।। 6.67.101 ।।

translations.english: His limbs smeared with fat and blood, with wreaths of entrails hanging on his ears, with sharp teeth, grown in his body to huge size, rained darts like the spirit of death at the end of the world.
